text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Daiwa Scarlet failed to show up
for training, and after waiting until evening—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Could it be... you were waiting for me this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, you're really something...
...Sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The doctor told me to rest, but honestly,
I'm not tired at all, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And when I told them I was fine,
it somehow turned into an argument, and now it's this late...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, let's start practicing right now!
To stay number one, there's no time to rest!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Daiwa Scarlet seemed to be pushing herself quite hard over the past few days.
choice_data_list: There's no need to push yourself.
You don't have to push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hmph!
You really are just completely carefree, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well... alright, I understand.
I'd hate missing out on training even more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet reflected deeply on what happened.
